messages:
Alex K: Quick handoff — I'm stepping out in ~10m (leaving desk at 2026-03-14T05:10Z). Jun will be primary for the overnight window, I'm secondary until 05:30Z.

Alex K: Can folks confirm PagerDuty, AWS cross-account, and Grafana dashboards are all green for Jun? If there are gaps, call them out now so we can patch before I go.

Samir: confirmed Jun is on the 'platform-oncall' PD schedule and has primary routing. I added Jun to the escalation policy yesterday. Jun should be able to acknowledge, but check you can trigger the platform escalation.

Jun: I can see the PD schedule and I can ack alerts, thanks. One gap: I don't currently have "RedwoodProdAssumeRole" access to prod-west account (need for runbook steps that require logs + heap dumps). I can still triage many issues, but for anything requiring console access or ECS exec I'll need a temp role.

Maria L: I can grant a temporary session via AWS SSO/SCIM. Two options: 1) add Jun to the Oncall-Temp SCIM group (fast, auto-provision) or 2) have Jun assume the role via CLI with a short-lived ARN. Which do you prefer?

Jun: SCIM group is fine if it's fast. If not, I can run assume-role.

Maria L: I'll add Jun to Oncall-Temp now for a 4h window. Note: Oncall-Temp gives Viewer+ECSExec. For full admin (rare) we use "Breakglass" which requires 2-person approval.

Maria L: Adding now... ok I'm getting an Okta confirmation popup. Should be provisioned in ~90s.

ops-bot: Provisioning event: user Jun added to group Oncall-Temp (duration 4h) — source: Okta SCIM; ticket 5842.

Jun: I see the group now, trying an assume/exec test:

Jun: ```
# verify role via SSO profile
aws sso login --profile redwood-prod
aws sts get-caller-identity --profile redwood-prod
# quick assume (if needed)
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOncall --role-session-name overnight-janesession
```

Jun: get-caller-identity returned the expected account. I also ran an `ecs execute-command` test on a staging task (no perms error). Good to go for console/exec workflows.

Samir: Grafana: make sure Jun has Viewer access to the core dashboards (latency, infra, model-serving). If you need Editor for annotations, request it explicitly. I just checked: Jun is Viewer on org "Redwood-Prod".

Alex K: Important runbook links: https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall/runbooks/access-and-handoff and https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall/runbooks/pagerduty-escalation.

Alex K: Quick checklist before I leave:
- PD: Jun is primary (checked)
- AWS: SCIM group added, assume/exec tested (checked)
- Grafana: Viewer access (checked)
- Runbooks: links available (checked)
- APAC gap: we normally have late-night coverage from APAC; tonight there is no APAC overlap. Jun, do you want me to page the secondary from EU if something shows up between 01:00-03:00Z?

Jun: If anything looks noisy between 01:00-03:00Z and it's not obvious mitigable, please page EU secondary (Olivia). I can handle until 02:30Z but prefer EU escalation after that window.

Samir: noted — Olivia is on-call in EU and is reachable. I can add Olivia to the PD incident if you want early.

Alex K: please do add Olivia to incident if anything time-sensitive comes up. For anything customer-impacting (500s, long tail latency >2min, or major data loss) escalate to platform-sre via PD and call bridge. Use incident template "prod-high-latency".

incident-bot: INC2001 created by PD auto-rule — threshold: p50 latency > 750ms for 10m on model-serving; paging policy: primary -> secondary -> platform-sre.

Jun: ACK INC2001, investigating logs now. Initial observation: spike from inference-gateway in prod-west. Pulling logs and metrics.

Jun: If I need console-level dumps I have the exec access now. Will update in-thread.

Alex K: thanks — I'll be reachable by text for 30m in case you need a hand for context. Otherwise I'm out. Good luck. :thumbsup:

Samir: all set, thanks Alex. Jun, ping if you want me to add Olivia to PD early.

Jun: will do. For now triaging.

Maria L: FYI — if anyone needs longer access beyond 4h, submit request to infra-requests@redwood and tag me for faster approval.

Jun: Closing loop: PD + AWS + Grafana access verified, runbooks linked, EU escalation path noted. Leaving notes in the incident.

Alex K: Perfect — handing off.

Samir: :thumbsup:.
